messages:
sylvie: dropping a tiny 'flashcard' pack for reviews — one-line IC answers + 2-line manager replies. includes hiring-ops and benefits/policy snippets. very paste-friendly. :flashlight:

harry: love the format. can we add a tiny FAQ line for benefits owners?
jo: also a short hiring-ops KR example so managers can tie goals to headcount.
sylvie: added both. kept everything 1-2 lines so it scans during calibration. people-ops-bot: Reminder: review window opens next Tue — tag this thread if you want it added to templates.

sylvie: --- IC FLASHCARDS (copy 1 line each) ---
- Elevator role line: "I own [area] by [action], enabling [customer/org impact]."
- Outcome metric: "Reduced token cost per request by 22% through batching & cache."
- Hiring-ops KR (1 line): "Mentored 2 hires, reduced their time-to-first-commit from 4w -> 2w, enabling earlier capacity."
- Benefits/policy KR (1 line): "Drafted parental leave FAQ and automated benefits enrollment flow, cutting manual ops by 70%."
- Quick regret: "Would have started rollout docs earlier to avoid late-migration bugs."

sylvie: --- MANAGER PAIRS (paste 2 short lines) ---
- Observation: "Delivered measurable cost and latency wins; validated via perf dashboard and canary traces."
- Suggested next step: "Assign owner to codify runbook and schedule a 3-week follow-up to ensure adoption."

sylvie: --- HIRING-OPS MANAGER LINE (1 line) ---
- "Clear onboarding plan and mentorship evidence; hire ramp metrics confirm early productivity."

sylvie: --- BENEFITS/POLICY MANAGER LINE (1 line) ---
- "Owned policy rollout and automation; reduced manual reviews and lowered support volume."

sylvie: --- PEER DM (one-line ask templates) ---
- Ask (fast): "Hey @NAME — 2 quick lines on my handoff & clarity during the rollout? Appreciate it!"
- Ask (hiring): "Hey @NAME — could you note how onboarding/mentorship went for the new hire I supported? 1-2 lines ideal."

harry: these are great. very usable in a pinch. i like the benefits KR — fills a gap.
jo: i pasted the hiring line into my calibration notes. saves me a bunch of writing.
sylvie: cool 604 if folks want, i can make a PM/design variant with non-technical metric examples. people-ops-bot: Tip: include this thread_ts when requesting template inclusion in the review form.
